Judge Reinstates U.S. Attorney Fired by Trump Administration

A federal judge has overturned a decision by the Trump administration to fire the U.S. attorney for Seattle, reinstating him to his position. The judge ruled against the administration's action, which had removed the prosecutor from his post.
